content:
neha: small proposal: add a compact 'inspect sample' flow in Console that shows per-route sampling rates + a redaction confidence indicator. goal: let devs triage actual failures quickly without broad PII exposure.

jord: +1. main Q: are we keeping separate debug vs audit streams, or one stream with metadata?

neha: one stream with metadata tags: inspect (Console ephemeral) and archive (secure audit store). inspect visible for 24h and requires breakglass, archive stored under stricter RBAC and retention.

carlos: defaults? we need conservative defaults to avoid cost or compliance surprises. propose inspect=0.01% for text-only routes, archive=0.001%. everything that accepts files/embeds auto-opt-out.

mei: display-wise: prefer banded redaction confidence (LOW/MED/HIGH) + short reason tags ("email", "ssn-like", "ocr-attachment") rather than raw floats. raw floats encourage bad heuristics.

harry: ops ask: must have a global emergency kill-switch to set all inspect rates to 0 instantly, plus per-org caps so tenants can't opt their way into a bill shock. show a Console banner when kill-switch is on.

audit-bot: policy-scan: route /v1/file-upload detected sensitivity=0.95 -> auto-opt-out applied.

neha: good flag. also require explicit tenant opt-in flow for any route that returns embeddings or handles attachments; log opt-ins to audit.

jord: can we surface a cost preview when someone changes a slider? i.e., projected monthly token delta = recent_30d_volume * avg_tokens * new_rate. Prefer a small inline calc and an "Estimate" button before commit.

carlos: yes - and if projected delta > org budget send an approval workflow. Also show expected number of samples per month to set expectations.

mei: breakglass flow: require a two-line justification and MFA check for sensitive tenants; store (actor, reason, timestamp) in immutable audit. TTL for inspect view = 24h. archive access uses RBAC.

harry: infra: implement priority order: global kill-switch > org cap > route override. also add an API to set kill-switch: `POST /admin/kill-switch?samples=off` with audit logging. can we add a sample curl for product?

neha: sure, add to RFC. example snippets below.

```yaml
# route config example
route: /v1/chat/completions
sampling:
  inspect_rate: 1e-4    # 0.01% inspect (Console visible for 24h)
  archive_rate: 1e-5    # 0.001% to audit store
redaction:
  strategy: mask-first
  display_confidence: banded  # LOW / MED / HIGH
  attachments: auto_opt_out
```

# emergency kill-switch example (infra API)
# curl -X POST https://infra.redwood/api/admin/kill-switch -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"samples":"off"}'

jord: UX: small badge near route: "inspect: 0.01% / archive: 0.001%" with a tooltip. clicking opens a lightweight panel listing N recent inspect hits (if any) with banded confidence, reason tags, and request metadata (route, tenant id). each inspect item must be opened with breakglass.

carlos: security caveat: don't show raw request body for medium-confidence items by default. instead show pre-scrub diff only when tenant opted in to diffs. default: show metadata + redaction snippets.

mei: operational telemetry: emit counters: inspect_samples_total, archive_samples_total, redaction_band_counts{route,band}. add a weekly job that computes regression signals vs gold prompt sets in Optimize and opens alerts if false-negative / over-scrub rates spike.
harry: also track "inspect_view_count" and who opened views for compliance reporting.

jaudit-bot: compliance-note: ensure retention and export controls exist for archive samples per tenant SLA.

neha: action items: I'll write a short RFC with these pieces and a tiny prototype of the Console badge + panel. infra owner: @harry for kill-switch + quota enforcement. product/UI owner: @jord for mocks and cost-estimator. security/compliance: @carlos + @mei to add opt-in templates and audit requirements.

jord: I'll mock the badge and a small cost preview that shows "~X samples/month -> ~$Y/month" before they commit.

carlos: I'll draft the tenant opt-in wording and the list of route patterns that are auto-opt-out (file-upload, embeddings, webhook-targets, payment_webhooks).

mei: one more edge-case: what about retry storms creating more samples? enforce sampling based on request_id dedupe window (e.g., dedupe ttl 5m) so retries of same request don't multiply samples. note in RFC.

harry: will implement dedupe and the kill-switch API. will also add a per-org monthly sample cap counter to prevent budget overrun.

neha: thanks team. I'll drop the RFC link in this thread when ready and tag reviewers. :eyes:
